description: Baseline permissions for the MYDAW main window. Commands defined by this app (get_ui_snapshot, transport_*, subscribe_meters, the project commands) are always allowed; this covers the built-in core plugins, plus the file dialogs the project commands open. Only `dialog:allow-open` and `dialog:allow-save` are granted -- the app never shows a message or confirm box, and a permission nothing uses is a permission that can be misused.
